items.title: Deadline to file Einspruch against interest assessment
items.quote: Sie können gegen diese Festsetzung innerhalb eines Monats Einspruch beim Finanzamt Beispielsoest erheben.
items.computation: Letter dated Thursday 19.11.2026; no separate 'zur Post gegeben am' date is stated, so the posting day equals the letter date, 19.11.2026. Sender is a Finanzamt, so the 4-day delivery fiction applies (§ 122 Abs. 2 Nr. 1 AO): day 1 = 20.11. (Fri), day 2 = 21.11. (Sat), day 3 = 22.11. (Sun), day 4 = 23.11.2026 (Mon). Since 23.11.2026 is a working day (Monday, no holiday), the delivery (Bekanntgabe) date stays 23.11.2026 and is not shifted. Per § 355 Abs. 1 AO the one-month Einspruchsfrist runs from this Bekanntgabe; under §§ 108 Abs. 1 AO, 187 Abs. 1, 188 Abs. 2 BGB the day of Bekanntgabe itself is not counted and the period ends one month later on the numerically corresponding day: 23.11.2026 + 1 month = 23.12.2026. 23.12.2026 is a Wednesday, not a weekend or public holiday in NW, so no further shift under § 108 Abs. 3 AO is needed.
